text:
sophia: Quick announcement — Shipping GA for hosted endpoint `delta-stream.v1` tomorrow 09:00 PT. This is the low-latency streaming + adaptive-priority routing stack.

luis: Nice! Any special migration steps for customers using `streammux.v1`?

sophia: We auto-map compatible routes. See mapping table in the doc: https://redwood-internal.company/docs/delta-stream-migration

marcus: Will it be enabled for free-tier or limited rollout?

sophia: Canary for existing POWER and DEDICATED customers today; broader tenant rollout starts next week. Free-tier will be opt-in behind a usage cap for the first month.

deploy-bot: deploy delta-stream.v1 to prod completed — image: rwinf/delta-stream:2026-03-22-rc4 — <@sophia> requested

emily: Ops note: watch for increased connection counts (we saw ~1.6x during canary), set client keepalive to 30s if you hit idle timeouts.

luis: Can we get a short snippet for SDK usage? I'll paste into the migration guide.

sophia: SDK example:
```js
const resp = await redwood.stream('delta-stream.v1', { prompt: '...', mode: 'low_latency' })
for await (const chunk of resp) {
  // handle chunk
}
```

marcus: Awesome. Any SLO changes/observability we should call out?

sophia: Updated dashboards in Console under Hosted → Endpoints → delta-stream.v1. New metrics: conn_count, avg_p95_latency, prewarm_hit_rate. Alerts: avg_p95_latency > 120ms for 5m.

emily: Noted — I'll add alert playbook in runbook.

sophia: Thanks team. Sending formal GA announcement to #announcements at 09:05 PT tomorrow. Ping me if you want early access keys.
